artworks.title: Cosimo II de' Medici, Grand Duke of Tuscany
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 20 × 13.3 cm (7 7/8 × 5 1/4 in.)
artworks.description: The image is an engraving of a man in an ornate oval frame. The man faces slightly to the right, having an elongated face with a mustache, short hair, a ruffled collar, and a decorated garment. Surrounding the frame are designs including a large-winged creature at the top and cherubic figures holding flags and armor. A heraldic shield with spheres is below the portrait. The background has intricate line work and decorative elements.

artworks.title: Smaralo Cornuto and Ratsa di Boio
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring stylized, anthropomorphic figures in a surreal scene. The foreground shows two large, fantastical characters: one with a long beak-like nose, a pointed hat or horn, and a dark cloak; the other with exaggerated muscular features, a billowing scarf, and a masked face with long feathers. They are depicted in motion, interacting with each other. In the midground, several smaller figures are engaged in various activities, some holding sticks or props. The background shows simple structures hinting at a village setting. The overall composition, with mysterious, masked characters, suggests a sense of carnival or theatrical performance. The lines are clear and lively, giving a dynamic feel to the scene.

artworks.title: Scaramucia and Fricasso
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two stylized figures engaged in a duel with swords. The two figures, labeled "Scaramucia" and "Fricasso," are depicted in dynamic poses with swords drawn. They wear elaborate costumes, including broad-brimmed hats with feathers. The background contains small figures and architectural elements, giving the impression of a broader scene. The style of the drawing includes fine lines and attention to theatrical costume details.

artworks.title: Scapino and Cap. Zerbino
artworks.description: The image shows two full-bodied figures in theatrical costumes labeled "Scapino" and "Cap. Zerbino." "Scapino" has an elongated nose, a hat with feathers, a long coat, a striped outfit, and a sword. "Cap. Zerbino" also has an elongated nose, a feathered hat, a detailed jacket, and distinctive shoes. Both figures have expressive postures. In the background, several figures interact, with buildings and trees on each side, and a bag on the ground between them.

artworks.title: Bello Sguardo and Coviello
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two fantastical figures facing each other atop a landscape with smaller figures and buildings in the background. The drawing depicts two muscular creatures with exaggerated limbs, each brandishing a large sword and holding a cloak or cloth that billows behind them. They appear to be in motion, with dynamic poses suggesting combat or a ritualistic dance. The background features smaller human-like figures observing the scene, as well as distant architectural structures, possibly a cityscape. The title "Bello Sguardo" is inscribed below the figure on the left, and "Couiello" below the figure on the right. This artwork has a detailed pen and ink style.

artworks.title: Il Solimano, Act V
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 20.7 × 25.3 cm (8 1/8 × 9 15/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a historical scene. The drawing depicts a city engulfed in turmoil and fire. The buildings line a broad street, and classical architecture is visible, with arches and columns. Figures are dispersed throughout the streets, depicting chaos and movement. Some figures are shown in combat, holding shields and weapons, while others appear to be fleeing or lying on the ground. The drawing is detailed, with intricate linework capturing the energy and intensity of the scene.

artworks.title: Franca Trippa and Fritellino
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two costumed figures engaging in a lively performance. The image features two characters labeled 'Franca Trippa' and 'Fritellino,' both wearing exaggerated outfits with long feathers in their hats and engaging in animated postures. The figures are drawn in a stylized manner typical of caricatures, with their features exaggerated for comedic effect. The background shows a group of buildings and several smaller figures, possibly an audience or fellow performers. The drawing suggests a vibrant and humorous depiction, capturing a theatrical or festival atmosphere.

artworks.title: The Massacre of the Innocents
artworks.description: The image depicts a scene viewed from an elevated angle, showing a bustling and chaotic crowd below. The composition is framed within an oval shape with various figures interacting in the center. A tall building with ornate details is on the left, while another building is on the right. Smaller structures in the distance give the scene depth. The background features streaky lines suggesting clouds. The image is monochromatic, using shades of brown with intricate line work and cross-hatching to show texture and shadow.

artworks.title: Piazza SS. Annunziata, Florence
artworks.description: The image displays a town square from an elevated perspective. A figure in period clothing leans on a cane while overlooking the scene below. The square is bustling with people engaging in various activities, and a statue is at the center. Elegant buildings with arches and domes form the horizon, serving as a backdrop. The artwork features intricate line work, possibly created with pen or etching techniques, and a monochrome color palette with a sepia tone. The detailed scene conveys a sense of historical vitality and architectural grandeur.

artworks.title: Fireworks on the Arno, Florence
artworks.description: The image shows a bird's eye view of a public square with various activities happening. The horizon is high in the composition, displaying a wide landscape with an urban setting in the distance. The horizon line showcases structures like domes and city buildings, suggesting a bustling city life. The scene is depicted in a linear style with fine line work typical of etching, detailing figures and architectural elements. The color palette is monochromatic, emphasizing brown and sepia tones for an aged effect. People are engaging in activities near the bottom, including walking, riding horses, and pulling carts. In the distance, there is a fountain or fireworks display as a focal point, with a cityscape and bridge framing the scene.

artworks.title: Piazza Santa Maria Novella, Florence
artworks.description: This is an image of a city square with historic architecture, carriages, and figures. The foreground includes a figure in a hat and cloak standing on a balcony, overlooking the bustling square. The square is surrounded by classical buildings, with a prominent structure on the right featuring columns and a pediment. Various small figures and carriages are present in the square, engaging in different activities. The style of the drawing is characterized by fine lines and detailed depiction of architecture and figures, typical of etchings from the 17th or 18th century.

artworks.title: Piazza Presso alla Porta al Prato
artworks.description: The image shows a town square with a race or parade happening. There are various architectural structures in the background, with people on horseback, carriages, and groups of people in intricate attire. The artwork is depicted in a line-oriented style, with a monochromatic color palette and fine details.

artworks.title: Captain of the Barons
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 14.4 × 9.5 cm (5 11/16 × 3 3/4 in.)
artworks.description: The man is walking in an angled position, leaning slightly forward. He has rugged facial features with a bushy beard and hair peeking out from under a hat adorned with a long feather. He wears loose, worn clothing, including a long-sleeved tunic with tattered edges, baggy pants that gather at the ankles, and simple footwear. He carries a large flag or banner that reads "CAPITANO DE BARONI" on his back, draped over a stout bag suspended from a pole resting on his shoulder, which he holds with his right hand. The background features a bustling scene with various figures engaged in activities. There is a church-like building and rocky formations with sparse trees visible, suggesting a village or small town setting.

artworks.title: Louis de Lorraine, Prince of Phalsbourg
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 28.8 × 34 cm (11 5/16 × 13 3/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image is an engraving of a man on a horse. The man is positioned atop the rearing horse, leaning slightly forward. He has distinct facial features with a mustache and curly hair. His attire resembles armor with a cloak or sash. He holds a baton or riding crop in his left arm, with no visible jewelry. The background shows a battle scene with troops, horses, and mountains under a cloudy sky. The engraving has intricate detailing, especially in the horse and the man's attire.

artworks.title: Noble Woman with a Small Hat
artworks.description: The image shows a full-body portrait of a person standing upright. The individual is facing slightly towards the left, with hands clasped at waist level. The person has distinct facial features, including prominent eyes and a slightly open mouth. Their hair is styled upwards, with the addition of a tall, narrow hat or headdress. The person wears ornate clothing typical of the period, featuring an elaborately decorated dress with large sleeves, intricate patterns, and a wide, ruffled collar. A long necklace with a pendant hangs vertically from the waist. The background reveals a busy street scene with several small structures and figures engaged in various activities. The image is monochromatic and appears to be an etching or engraving.

artworks.title: Noble Man with Felt Hat, Bowing
artworks.description: The image shows a man walking to the right. He is holding a small drum with his right hand and has his left hand raised near his face. He has distinct facial features with a mustache and a small beard, long hair flowing backward. He is dressed in a fur-lined cloak, with decorative elements at the knee, and shoes adorned with large rosettes. The background shows a town or village scene with various figures, buildings, and hills in the distance.

artworks.title: Soldier with Feathered Hat
artworks.description: The image shows a full-body illustration of a man standing with his legs slightly apart and his body turned towards the viewer. He has a moustached face with a firm expression and is adorned in a wide-brimmed hat with a sweeping plume. His hair appears voluminous and flows down from under the hat. The man is dressed in an elaborate outfit featuring a ruffled collar, a fitted jacket with buttons down the front, billowing trousers, and boots that gather at the ankles. He clutches a sword scabbard in his left hand, with the hilt visible under his right arm. The background depicts a scene of horseback riders and a distant landscape. There is an artist's signature, "Callot," in the lower left corner of the image.

artworks.title: Masked Noble Woman
artworks.description: This print shows a woman standing upright, wearing an intricately designed dress with voluminous sleeves, pleated skirts, lacy cuffs, and a large, ruffled collar. Her face is partly obscured by a dark mask, but she seems to be smiling slightly. She has hair styled around her ears and adorned with a feather, and she wears earrings and a necklace. She holds a flower in one hand and has the other on her hip. In the background there are several groups of people walking on a wide street lined with buildings. The sky above is blank.

artworks.title: The Fair at Xeuilley
artworks.description: The image shows a scene of a rural community in an etching. The viewpoint allows viewers to see the gathering and surroundings. A lower horizon includes distant hills and small buildings. A large tree with detailed branches and foliage is at the center. People are engaged in various activities, including dancing and socializing. Animals like horses and dogs are also present. The artist uses fine lines to show texture and form. The color palette is monochromatic in sepia and black tones, emphasizing texture and line work. The composition depicts a bustling rural life.

artworks.title: The Palace Gardens at Nancy
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 25.7 × 38.5 cm (10 1/8 × 15 3/16 in.)
artworks.description: The view of a formal garden within a palace courtyard is shown from an elevated perspective, giving a sense of looking down from a structure. The horizon line is high with buildings framing the garden and a distant landscape in the background. The engraving style is detailed with fine lines, capturing intricate designs. The color palette is monochromatic in sepia tones. Figures can be seen in the garden engaging in various activities. In the middle, there are symmetrical geometric and ornamental garden beds surrounded by pathways and statues.

artworks.title: Frontispiece for "The Combat at the Barrier"
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 15.8 × 10.4 cm (6 1/4 × 4 1/8 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an elaborate heraldic composition. The drawing features a central coat of arms adorned with intricate patterns and forms, surrounded by two allegorical figures, each holding long palm or laurel branches. At the top, a drapery with ornate floral garlands frames the scene. The coat of arms is crowned and accompanied by a variety of heraldic elements. Below, the composition is further embellished with a decorative cartouche containing a poetic inscription. The intricate line work and careful detailing reflect mastery of engraving techniques typical of the Baroque period.

artworks.title: Entry of the Prince of Pfaltzbourg
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 15.5 × 24.2 cm (6 1/8 × 9 1/2 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate procession involving carriages and figures. The drawing displays a ceremonial or theatrical scene with a procession of individuals in elaborate costumes. The upper part depicts figures holding torches followed by musicians playing drums. A larger procession of figures is pulling a decorated carriage with winged and mythological motifs. The lower part shows another carriage with ornately dressed figures, surrounded by clouds. There are figures playing musical instruments in the foreground and an empty ornate chair among cloud-like formations. The detailed artwork suggests a celebratory or mythological theme. The style and execution may resemble the work of Jacques Callot, known for intricate etchings.

artworks.title: Entry of M. de Macey
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 15.3 × 22.2 cm (6 × 8 3/4 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a detailed procession. The black and white illustration features several small figures arranged in a parade-like formation. Each figure wears elaborate outfits with plumed hats and carries various musical instruments or weapons. Some figures are playing drums, others carrying sticks or long poles with ornate structures. The scene is meticulously composed, capturing the movement and coordination of the figures in the procession. The overall style suggests historical or ceremonial significance, with an emphasis on pageantry and display.

artworks.title: Entry of Mm. de Vroncourt, Tyllon, and Marimont
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 14.9 × 22.3 cm (5 7/8 × 8 3/4 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of sea creatures with human figures mounted on them. The drawing features two large, mythical sea creatures with exaggerated features like wide mouths and flippers. One creature is ridden by three human figures holding poles and wearing elaborate costumes, while another figure straddles the second creature while playing a musical instrument. The sea creatures are depicted with undulating bodies and wide eyes as they swim across a body of water.
